summary: Clear Array: empties a shared array (removes all items) when Do fires.
description: When `clear` (Do) fires, resolves `collectionId` (Array Id) to the shared array, replaces its contents with an empty list, and fires `modified` (Done). The Array Id must be set before the signal arrives. The objects that were in the array are not destroyed — only the array is emptied — and every node bound to the same Array Id sees the empty array immediately.
whenToUse: Reset-style actions on local shared arrays ('clear the list', 'empty the cart'). To remove a single item use Remove Object From Array; this node is all-or-nothing.

ports.clear: Signal input (Do); empties the array. Requires `collectionId` to be set.
ports.collectionId: Value input: id of the shared array to empty.
ports.modified: Signal (Done); fires after the array has been emptied.
